allow: Bash(node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require\('node:sqlite'\); const db=new DatabaseSync\('data/list.db'\); console.log\('levels w/ gd_id:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM levels WHERE gd_id IS NOT NULL'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('void w/ gd_id:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM void_levels WHERE gd_id IS NOT NULL'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('awaiting w/ gd_id:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM awaiting_levels WHERE gd_id IS NOT NULL'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('cache rows:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM gd_info_cache'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('missing main:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM levels l WHERE l.gd_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS \(SELECT 1 FROM gd_info_cache c WHERE c.gd_id=l.gd_id\)'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('missing void:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM void_levels l WHERE l.gd_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS \(SELECT 1 FROM gd_info_cache c WHERE c.gd_id=l.gd_id\)'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('missing awaiting:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM awaiting_levels l WHERE l.gd_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS \(SELECT 1 FROM gd_info_cache c WHERE c.gd_id=l.gd_id\)'\).get\(\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require\('node:sqlite'\); const db=new DatabaseSync\('data/list.db'\); console.log\('levels w/ gd_id:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM levels WHERE gd_id IS NOT NULL'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('levels total:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM levels'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('sample gd_ids:', db.prepare\('SELECT gd_id, name FROM levels WHERE gd_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3'\).all\(\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require\('node:sqlite'\); const db=new DatabaseSync\('data/list.db'\); console.log\('cache rows:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM gd_info_cache'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('latest:', db.prepare\(\\"SELECT gd_id, fetched_at FROM gd_info_cache ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 3\\"\).all\(\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require\('node:sqlite'\); const db=new DatabaseSync\('data/list.db'\); console.log\('first 5 ids to fetch:', db.prepare\(\\"SELECT DISTINCT l.gd_id FROM levels l WHERE l.gd_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.gd_id LIMIT 5\\"\).all\(\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require\('node:sqlite'\); const db=new DatabaseSync\('data/list.db'\); console.log\('records total:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM records'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('user-submitted:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM records WHERE submitted_by IS NOT NULL'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('permanent levels:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM levels WHERE permanent=1'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('non-permanent levels:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM levels WHERE permanent=0 OR permanent IS NULL'\).get\(\)\);")
